nodes.label: Operator cannot reach the Admin API — loopback-only Admin TCP
nodes.rationale: Admin TCP is plaintext gRPC with a bearer token as its only security boundary, so it always binds loopback-only; the UDS is pod-local. Exposing admin-tcp on the ClusterIP Service would ship exactly the interceptable-bearer vulnerability the controller guards against.

nodes.label: Decision: UDS admin-exec sidecar (Option 1)
nodes.rationale: Least-invasive path needing no controller change and no plaintext bearer on the wire; costs pods/exec RBAC and an exec-based FabricAdmin transport, with the TCP client retained for out-of-cluster and test use.
